mapper.select: select a.accommodation_no as accommodationNo, a.accommodation_name as accommodationName, a.accommodation_address as accommodationAddress, r.room_price as roomPrice, r.room_discount as roomDiscount, round((r.room_price*(1-(r.room_discount / 100)))) as discountedPrice, r.room_discount as roomDiscount,i.filename as filename from accommodation a join room r on a.accommodation_no = r.accommodation_no join room_image i on a.accommodation_no = i.accommodation_no where (r.room_price*(1-(r.room_discount / 100))) = ( select min(room_price * (1-(room_discount / 100))) from room where accommodation_no = a.accommodation_no);

WITH SelectedAccommodations AS ( SELECT a.accommodation_no FROM accommodation a GROUP BY a.accommodation_no ORDER BY a.accommodation_no DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} )
SELECT a.accommodation_no AS accommodationNo, a.accommodation_name AS accommodationName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.accommodation_address,' ',2) AS accommodationAddress, r.room_price AS roomPrice, r.room_discount AS roomDiscount, ROUND(r.room_price * (1 - (r.room_discount / 100))) AS discountedPrice, i.filename AS filename FROM accommodation a JOIN room r ON a.accommodation_no = r.accommodation_no JOIN room_image i ON a.accommodation_no = i.accommodation_no WHERE a.accommodation_no IN (SELECT accommodation_no FROM SelectedAccommodations) ORDER BY a.accommodation_no DESC

SELECT a.accommodation_no as accommodationNo, count(review_no) as cnt,round(avg(review_rating),2) as reviewRating FROM accommodation a LEFT OUTER JOIN review r ON a.accommodation_no = r.accommodation_no GROUP BY a.accommodation_no;
